leadText:
The Shell Sage (Japanese: カメマスター Turtle Master) is a character of the day who appeared in Eyes on the Goal!.

He appeared at the end of Eyes on the Goal!, riding on top of a group of , where he called out to his Pokémon that were taking part in a race across a park against .
